full_prompt_en: A square painterly illustration shows a solitary woman sitting in a coral-colored rowboat on still turquoise water under a broad sky. The horizon is low and hazy, so sky and water seem to belong to nearly the same blue-green field. Large, irregular cream clouds rise on the left and reappear at the upper right, with scraped and broken edges that expose flecks of turquoise beneath them. Tiny pale bird marks scatter through the open upper sky. Slightly right of center, the small boat floats in profile, its light interior rim tracing a narrow horizontal oval. The left side of the hull is warm coral red, rubbed thin in places so lighter paint and dark underlayers show through; the right end is darker, weathered brown and black. The seated woman faces away from the viewer toward the distant open space. Dark shoulder-length hair forms a simple silhouette above a vivid red-orange dress, whose folds are indicated by a few broad value changes. She is small within the expanse and does not command the frame through detail. Below the boat, its red hull repeats as broken vertical reflections interrupted by thin turquoise ripples, while a dark patch grounds the right end in the water. The clouds also return as broad pale fragments in the lower half, their edges softened and displaced by the reflected surface. Light is diffuse, as if filtered through a bright overcast sky; it gives the pale clouds gentle warmth and makes the coral paint the clearest accent. The image has a worn, matte surface with visible brush drags, small scratches, flecks, and dry patches instead of seamless digital gradients. The overall composition is spacious and quiet, balancing one compact warm form against expansive cool color and loosely mirrored light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、绘画感鲜明的插画呈现一位女子独坐在珊瑚红色划艇中，漂浮于静谧的青绿色水面和宽阔天空之间。地平线低而朦胧，天空与水域几乎连成同一片蓝绿色。大片不规则的乳白色云从左侧升起，并在右上方再次出现；刮擦般破碎的边缘露出下方斑点状青绿色。上方开阔天空散落着细小浅色飞鸟笔迹。稍偏中央右侧，小船以侧面漂浮，浅色内沿勾出狭窄的水平椭圆。左侧船身呈温暖珊瑚红，局部颜料被磨薄，露出较浅的色层和深色底层；右端则是更深的、风化般的棕黑色。坐着的女子背对观者，面向远处空旷处。齐肩深色头发形成简洁剪影，下面是一袭鲜明的红橙色裙子，衣褶仅由几处宽阔的明度变化提示。她在大片空间中显得很小，并不靠细节占据画面。船下方，红色船身化为断续的竖向倒影，被细窄的青绿色波纹截开；深色区域则将船的右端稳在水中。云也以大片浅色碎影回到下半部，边界被反射水面柔化并错移。光线漫射，仿佛穿过明亮的阴天，使浅色云带有温和暖意，并让珊瑚红成为最醒目的色彩重音。画面呈磨旧的哑光表面，可见拖开的笔痕、小刮痕、斑点和干涩色块，而非无缝数字渐层。整体构图宽阔而安静，用一个紧凑的暖色形体平衡大片冷色与松散映出的光。
style_prompt_en: The painterly image is built from broad turquoise and muted blue-green fields interrupted by warm coral and creamy off-white accents. Pigment looks rubbed, scraped, and dragged across a matte surface, leaving dry edges, small gaps, and irregular flecks. Large softly broken shapes coexist with a few crisp dark seams, so the eye moves between atmospheric openness and compact detail. Reflected color is fragmented into short horizontal and vertical strokes rather than rendered as a smooth mirror. Diffuse brightness gives pale areas a gentle warmth without hard cast shadows. A low concentration of forms beneath generous open space establishes a meditative balance, while one small saturated accent carries the visual focus. The overall effect is weathered, airy, and quietly luminous.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅绘画感画面由大面积青绿与低饱和蓝绿色铺成，穿插暖珊瑚红和乳白色重音。颜料仿佛在哑光表面反复擦抹、刮去和拖开，留下干涩边缘、小片露底和不规则斑点。大片轻柔破碎的形状与少数清晰深色接缝并存，使视线在氛围感的开阔与紧凑细节之间移动。反射色被拆成短促的横竖笔触，而不是平滑的镜面。漫射亮光让浅色区域带上温和暖意，却没有硬朗投影。形体低位聚集、上方宽裕留白，形成冥想般的平衡；一个小面积高饱和重音承担视觉焦点。整体效果风化、通透而安静地发亮。
theme_en: A solitary woman in a coral boat on still turquoise water
theme_zh: 静谧青绿水面上一位独坐珊瑚红小船的女子
name: Clare Elsaesser
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
